status_note: fixed upstream in 30.30.0 ([#8890](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/8890), PR [#8893](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/pull/8893)); the repro keeps the `USING` columns in `t.*` on 30.30.0.
summary: `qualify` expands `t.*` of the right table of a `JOIN … USING` without the `USING` columns; DuckDB keeps them in `t.*` (only `*` shows them once).
repro: `SELECT a.*, b.* FROM a JOIN b USING (i)`: DuckDB gives 4 columns, the qualified tree 3.
